verdicts_or_reports.expected: One IrisSeed album card should contain both seeded photos (2 items).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Albums tab shows two IrisSeed cards: one for big.jpg and one for huge.jpg, each with “1 items”.
steps: Open Albums and open the IrisSeed album containing big.jpg and huge.jpg.
Open big.jpg, open Details, then Edit metadata & EXIF.
On Origin, enter 2020-01-02 03:04 in Captured and Save.
Return to Albums. The index shows separate IrisSeed cards for big.jpg and huge.jpg, each with 1 item.
Open the big.jpg card, return to Albums, and confirm the split remains.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After setting an EXIF capture date of 2020-01-02 03:04, the details sheet should show that capture date.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The sheet shows only Added and Modified dates (November 15, 2026 · 8:43 PM and November 15, 2026 · 8:45 PM); there is no capture date row.
steps: Open IrisSeed and open big.jpg.
Open Details, then Edit metadata & EXIF.
On Origin, set Captured to 2020-01-02 03:04 and Save.
Leave the photo and reopen it, then open Details.
The sheet still shows only Added and Modified; it does not show the EXIF capture date.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The saved capture date 2020-01-02 03:04 should remain in the Captured field when the editor is reopened.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After tapping Save and reopening the editor, the Captured field is empty and shows its format placeholder.
steps: Open big.jpg in IrisSeed and open Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin.
Enter 2020-01-02 03:04 in Captured.
Tap Save.
Immediately reopen Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin.
Captured is blank again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After saving metadata, the title and image description should remain when the photo is reopened.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The title and image description are accepted by Save and shown in Details, but after leaving the photo and opening it again both fields are blank.
steps: Open huge.jpg in IrisSeed and open Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Description.
Enter QA Iris test as Title and QA metadata persists as Image Description, then tap Save.
Confirm the values appear in Details, then leave the photo to the album grid.
Reopen huge.jpg from the album and open Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Description.
Both fields are blank and show their placeholders.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The time inserted by Set Current Time should remain in the Captured field after Save and reopening the editor.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Set Current Time displayed 2026-11-15 20:56:18 before Save, but the reopened Captured field is blank.
steps: Open huge.jpg > Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin.
Tap Set Current Time; verify the field displays the generated date and time.
Tap Save.
Reopen Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin.
The Captured field is blank again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Camera Model should retain QA Model 123 after Save and reopening the editor.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The value QA Model 123 was accepted and Save returned to Details, but the reopened Camera & Lens tab shows an empty Camera Model field.
steps: Open huge.jpg > Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Camera & Lens.
Enter QA Model 123 in Camera Model and tap Save.
Reopen Edit metadata & EXIF > Camera & Lens.
Camera Model is blank again.
